flags.item: Repeated matchups printed by the official schedule: POR@MIN on both 11/16 and 11/17, NYK@TOR on both 11/15 and 11/17 (same venues).
flags.detail: Two independent sessions transcribed these rows from NBA.com with distinct game IDs; carried as printed and flagged for manual confirmation against the live schedule page.

flags.item: No home-court advantage in any line.
flags.detail: HCA could not be sourced from an official NBA page; home moneylines are understated by exactly the real HCA.

flags.item: Stale inputs, disclosed: ratings through 11/12 games; records pre-11/13 (F-C02); 11/13 finals missing at build time (F-C01).
flags.detail: Every pick built on these lines is labelled MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED and stamped with this as-of date.

flags.item: No injury report yet covers 11/15-11/17 games.
flags.detail: Latest official edition in repo is 11/13 05:15 PM ET. Game-day reports (noon ET) had not been published at build time.

flags.item: DEN@NOP (11/14) printed NOT YET SUBMITTED for both teams.
flags.detail: Verbatim from the official PDF; no status is invented.

flags.item: Edwards, Anthony (MIN) listed Out for 11/14; no line adjustment applied.
flags.detail: His minutes/points are verified (33.7 / 33.3), but no official in-repo evidence classifies the absence as NEW relative to the ratings window (gp 4 of MIN's 12 games: 8 prior misses already in season stats). Canonical NEW_ABSENCE rule (scripts/injury_impact.py) -> adjustment 0.

flags.item: No market prices exist anywhere on this page.
flags.detail: No sportsbook feed is reachable or claimed; every probability is model-internal. Market-comparison gates (G4/G5) stay blocked.

flags.item: No strategy has passed the validation gates (Build A 0/8, Build B 0/10).
flags.detail: Every pick is therefore MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED, unfunded, and capped at zero stake until a strategy passes the gates. Outcomes: data/derived/strategies.json (Build A), docs/data/leaderboard.json (Build B) — internal artifacts, not official NBA sources.
